subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should this broad issue remain the canonical design umbrella, or should maintainers designate narrow canonical issues for evaluation metrics, normal-session continuity, and restart-time preload?
rationale: The remaining work crosses privacy scope, API shape, defaults, cost, and Gateway lifecycle behavior; current code establishes mechanisms but not the intended product contract.

options.title: Split into narrow contracts
options.body: Designate existing continuity issues where they fit, create one focused metrics contract, and track restart lifecycle separately so each decision can be reviewed independently.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Retain this issue as the canonical design tracker while requiring separate scoped implementation issues or pull requests under it.

recommendation.title: Split into narrow contracts
recommendation.body: Designate existing continuity issues where they fit, create one focused metrics contract, and track restart lifecycle separately so each decision can be reviewed independently.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available cross-surface history and authored the prior review direction covering memory, usage, and startup behavior.
